activation.note: Activation retains the invariant over every concrete item, explicitly including unchanged defective items. Change signals are optional, the plan path glob is explicitly not an item locator, and item recognition and phase/change detection honestly require new observers. Cross-profile duplicate reporting remains applicable rather than becoming an exemption.

audit.summary: All 32 segments survive at their claimed destinations; the coder receives the complete unique-wagon ownership invariant and its rationale. The source-specific example remains verifier reference material, while the shared strict-disposition node contains only generic enforcement policy.

segmentChecks.note: The given/when/then fields retain the invariant for every concrete item, exactly one declaring wagon, and an owner naming that wagon; activation also covers unchanged items.
The URN shape and the fact that produce[].telemetry may be a string or list survive explicitly in then, with the full declaration definition in verifier_detail.
prefer[1] says ownership is decided in the plan and the registry only resolves against it; avoid[2] rejects registry-granted ownership.
then preserves exactly one wagon rather than mistakenly requiring exactly one produce entry; verifier_detail correctly counts distinct wagons.
then, evidence, and verifier_detail all require item.owner to equal the declaring wagon's slug.
prefer[0] retains both repair steps: declare the artifact on the producing wagon and set the item owner to that wagon.
The wagon-level planner-profile finding and item-level telemetry-profile finding remain separate and cumulative, with no waiver or exemption introduced.
Strict disposition remains in verifier_detail and the shared policy node; audit also retains the source comment naming atdd-bun, no advisory mode, and no ratchet baseline.
The validator type and planner_telemetry_plan reference are retained verbatim in audit, and evidence uses that validator's whole-plan result.

risks: No concrete tracking-plan item example is provided, so exact owner-field syntax and the mechanics of resolving an item to its logical artifact URN depend on the surrounding plan schema; the ownership decision itself is nevertheless explicit.

unobservable: file_kind=tracking_plan_item requires a new observer, including recognition of concrete items and resolution to their logical artifact URNs
phase=plan_validation or plan_authoring requires a new observer
change signals for item, produce telemetry, and owner changes require a new observer, although they are explicitly optional and not prerequisites

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the unique-wagon and owner-match invariant, rationale, repair, profile overlap, and strict enforcement without adding waiver creep. The coder-facing decision is clear; deterministic activation still depends on the explicitly declared new observers for concrete-item recognition and evaluation phase.
